definition: a hard building material made with cement
description: A back garden with a large above-ground pool standing on a wide concrete patio, its slabs marked out by straight joint lines. A young man in sunglasses lies on a patterned Persian rug spread on the concrete, propped on one elbow under a small black umbrella, sipping an orange drink through a straw. Behind him another man in a white T-shirt scrubs the wet concrete with a long-handled deck brush, pushing white soapy foam across the slabs. More rugs lie drying on the concrete and the whole patio is covered in suds and water.

en.question: What is spreading across the concrete?
